answer: Look at the delta, not the absolute. Each epoch samples a random slice of submissions and audits them, so a farm cannot know which of its 1,000 answers will be re-executed. Rewards convert to a slow vesting stream, paid against future work. The delta that matters is the cost of one failed sample against the gain from 1,000 passes. At a 5 percent sample, ten failures per 200 audits, a farm loses its bond before vesting clears. The haven closes, the ember dies, and the balance hits its nadir.
